the nuclear import of several proteins is impaired in importin α7-deficient cells, which suggests that the importin α7 isoform is not a general nuclear import factor but rather has a more specialized role.

the identification of importin α 8-specific transport cargoes and their role in early embryogenesis.
the identification of importin α 6 and 7 specific cargoes, which may contribute to the functional differences of importin α isoforms.

importin α7 is not a cargo-specific importin α isoform, but it has a role in nuclear import of a subset of cargos, including Brg1.

importin α7 is not a general nuclear import receptor but rather a specific receptor that transports a set of cargo proteins into the nucleus.

importin α subunits are not only differentially expressed but also bind a specific subset of proteins that may be involved in the unique functions of these subunits.
